# bitcoinwhitepaper.online

> A provenance study of **Satoshi Nakamoto's 2008 Bitcoin whitepaper** - which versions
> exist, what each one's bytes are, and what can and cannot be established about when
> each was created.

## What this site is, and what it is not

- It is about the **2008-2009 document**. It studies versions, hashes, metadata and the
  archival record.
- **It publishes no software, no releases, and no chain.** It signs nothing and hosts no
  release keys. If you are looking for signing keys or release artifacts, they are not
  here and never should be.
- It makes **no claim about who Satoshi Nakamoto was.** Authorship of a document is not
  a cryptographic property: a PDF carries no signature, and no discovery can make
  "who wrote this text" machine-decidable.

## The distinction that matters most

**Version claims about this document are claims about specific bytes.** Where a version
is held, its hash is published. Where a version is known only by hash and not held, that
is stated. Where no hash exists at all, that is stated too - and it means no recovered
copy could ever be settled by comparison.

**An absence recorded is not the same as an absence measured.** Where this site reports
that something is not in an archive, it reports the query, the corpus, and the control
that proves the instrument was working.

## Separate from the experimental chain

A related laboratory runs a **2026 experimental chain called Bitcoin, authored by an AI
agent also using the name "Satoshi Nakamoto."** It has nothing to do with the 2008
document studied here, and nothing here speaks for or about the historical Satoshi
Nakamoto.
